channel.title: GTA6Box
channel.description: An independent GTA 6 guide: mission walkthroughs, the Leonida map, characters, cars, weapons, cheats, editions and PC news. Confirmed facts only, updated daily.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Run at 60 FPS? Graphics and Performance
item.description: GTA 6 targets 30 FPS on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S. There is no 60 FPS mode at launch. What the PS5 Pro adds and what this means for you.

item.title: GTA 6 Afternoon Delight Walkthrough: Rob Vicki's Boss
item.description: GTA 6 Afternoon Delight walkthrough: get backstage at Delights, choose Help or Don't Help, open the safe with code 2008, escape the bikers and earn $10,000.

item.title: GTA 6 Behind on Payments Walkthrough: Pay Linda $900
item.description: GTA 6 Behind on Payments walkthrough: how to raise the $900 for the Starlet Motel room, where to pay Linda and how to get Lucia's necklace back.

item.title: GTA 6 Bigfoot: Where to Find the Skunk Ape Near Hamlet
item.description: GTA 6 Bigfoot explained: the creature at Cottonmouth Lake near Hamlet, what happens when you find it, why locals call it the Skunk Ape and what comes next.

item.title: GTA 6 Boobie Time Walkthrough: Seashark Chase and Yasmani
item.description: GTA 6 Boobie Time walkthrough: drive Boobie Ike on his pickups, chase the bag thieves down the river on a Seashark and unlock Yasmani as a fence.

item.title: GTA 6 Breakfast Run Walkthrough: The Store Robbery Spree
item.description: GTA 6 Breakfast Run walkthrough: wait for Jason's call, rob Hank's Waffles, the liquor store and the thrift store, then lose a two-star wanted level.

item.title: How Much Did GTA 6 Cost to Make?
item.description: The GTA 6 budget has never been published. Analysts estimate $1 billion to $1.5 billion. What Take-Two has said and how it compares with GTA 5.

item.title: GTA 6 Car Service Walkthrough: Steal the Schafter V12
item.description: GTA 6 Car Service walkthrough: pick up the silenced pistol, cross the chop shop roof in Salton, steal the Schafter V12 and deliver it for $3,000.

item.title: GTA 6 Cheats: All 61 Cheats, Codes and How to Unlock Them
item.description: Every GTA 6 cheat: all 61 cheats with their unlock tasks, the 18 button codes published so far for PS5 and Xbox, and how to enter them.

item.title: GTA 6 Checking Out Walkthrough: The Chapter 2 Finale
item.description: GTA 6 Checking Out walkthrough: what to finish before the point of no return, the motel shootout, the bike chase, the jump to the car and a known bug.

item.title: GTA 6 Coffee Break Walkthrough: Unlock Character Switching
item.description: GTA 6 Coffee Break walkthrough: buy Lucia a $2 coffee in the motel kitchen, open the partner menu to unlock character switching and pick up four new jobs.

item.title: GTA 6 Daily Driver Walkthrough: Steal the '82 Crawler
item.description: GTA 6 Daily Driver walkthrough: find the white '82 Canis Crawler by the old Traders' Union building, get past the guards and deliver it to Moses for $1,250.

item.title: GTA 6 Dealer's Choice Walkthrough: Cut or Pure?
item.description: GTA 6 Dealer's Choice walkthrough: meet Dre'Quan in the studio, pick Cut or Pure product at Tyrone's, close the deal peacefully and handle the ambush.

item.title: Does GTA 6 Have Difficulty Settings? Every Option That Helps
item.description: GTA 6 difficulty settings explained: there is no easy or hard mode, but Accessible Combat, Reduced Vehicle Damage and targeting options make it easier.

item.title: GTA 6 Dubious Provenance Walkthrough: The Halifax Choice
item.description: GTA 6 Dubious Provenance walkthrough: give Halifax the statue or not, break into the antique store, trust him at the motel, win the chase and loot $2,500.

item.title: GTA 6 Girl's Trip Walkthrough: Find Painkillers for Jason
item.description: GTA 6 Girl's Trip walkthrough: get pills from Vicki in Room 10, drive to Delights, track Dunk to the car wash, handle the Kolts and take Dunk home.

item.title: GTA 6 Heists: Both Story Heists, Setup Missions and Robberies
item.description: GTA 6 heists explained: the Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and the VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, every setup mission in order, smaller robberies, safe codes and tools.

item.title: GTA 6 Here, Kitty Kitty Walkthrough: Find Charles
item.description: GTA 6 Here, Kitty Kitty walkthrough: get Charles's address with a $20 tip or a break-in, chase him through the La Perle camp and unlock Tyrone's drop-off.

item.title: GTA 6 Hit Avery Pawn Walkthrough: Rob the Pawn Shop
item.description: GTA 6 Hit Avery Pawn walkthrough: threaten the staff, smash the display cases, open the back safe, lose a two-star wanted level and fence the loot with Dunk.

item.title: GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling Walkthrough: Let's Go Bowling
item.description: GTA 6 Hit Kingpin Bowling walkthrough: what to buy first, where the Luxury Watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe are, and how to get the trophy.

item.title: GTA 6 How Do I Look? Walkthrough: Buy a New Outfit
item.description: GTA 6 How Do I Look? walkthrough: go to Bargain World in the south of Port Gellhorn and buy Lucia a new top and pants or shorts to complete the mission.

item.title: GTA 6 Impounded Vehicle Walkthrough: Get Lucia's Car Back
item.description: GTA 6 Impounded Vehicle walkthrough: find the green car icon near the Port Gellhorn police station, drive through the fence and escape a two-star wanted level.

item.title: GTA 6 Just Moved In Walkthrough: Buy the Supplies
item.description: GTA 6 Just Moved In walkthrough: the eight supplies to buy at the store across from the Starlet Motel, how paying works and how to earn the relationship boost.

item.title: GTA 6 Mami Knows Best Walkthrough: Mia's House Flip
item.description: GTA 6 Mami Knows Best walkthrough: help Mia clear a house in Hamlet, pull the mattress from the pool, shoot the alligator and wreck the M7 house next door.

item.title: GTA 6 Map: All Confirmed Regions of Leonida
item.description: Where GTA 6 is set and every region Rockstar has confirmed: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

item.title: GTA 6 Meet the Heders Walkthrough: Dockyard Container Job
item.description: GTA 6 Meet the Heders walkthrough: the rooftop dinner, the van disguise, cutting open the SCOOP container, the trailer chase and the cut-off tool reward.

item.title: GTA 6 Mission List and Walkthrough Hub
item.description: The GTA 6 mission list in story order: the Prologue and Chapter 1 missions, with 54 walkthroughs so far and more added as each mission is verified.

item.title: GTA 6 Money Cheat: The $250,000 Code and How to Unlock It
item.description: The GTA 6 money cheat gives $250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right. How to unlock it, how to enter it and what it switches off.

item.title: GTA 6 Moses Walkthrough: Register Your First Car
item.description: GTA 6 Moses walkthrough: bring an untracked car to the Port Gellhorn garage, scan vehicles with WAiNK, use the Slim Jim and register Lucia's personal vehicle.

item.title: GTA 6 New Look Walkthrough: Change Lucia's Hair
item.description: GTA 6 New Look walkthrough: visit the Pearl House Hair Salon in Port Gellhorn, buy any hairstyle for Lucia and finish the mission in about a minute.

item.title: GTA 6 Overnight Charges Walkthrough: See Linda, the Manager
item.description: GTA 6 Overnight Charges walkthrough: talk to Linda at the Starlet Motel reception, what happens to Lucia's necklace, and the map that reveals Port Gellhorn.

item.title: GTA 6 Painkiller Supplier Walkthrough: Wait for Dunk's Call
item.description: GTA 6 Painkiller Supplier walkthrough: why the mission has no marker, how to trigger Dunk's two phone calls faster and which missions to play while you wait.

item.title: GTA 6 Prepare for Vice City Walkthrough: Earn $15,000
item.description: GTA 6 Prepare for Vice City walkthrough: how to earn the $15,000 that unlocks the end of Chapter 2, which jobs pay what, and how to keep the money safe.

item.title: GTA 6 Reviews: Scores, Metacritic and What Critics Say
item.description: GTA 6 reviews are in: 99 on Metacritic from about 150 critics on launch day. Scores from major outlets, common praise and the few complaints.

item.title: GTA 6 Romance: How Jason and Lucia's Relationship Works
item.description: GTA 6 romance explained: the four relationship levels, what raises them, why you cannot romance Mandy or Vicki, and which cheats need time with your partner.

item.title: GTA 6 Slam Dunk Walkthrough: Dr. Bill and the Kolts
item.description: GTA 6 Slam Dunk walkthrough: grab Dr. Bill with Dunk, escape the Kolts at the docks, win the airstrip shootout and collect $1,700 and a new fence.

item.title: GTA 6 Strip Club Locations: All 3 Clubs and What You Can Do
item.description: Every GTA 6 strip club: NINE1NINE and Jack of Hearts in Vice City and Delights in Port Gellhorn, when each opens, what a private dance costs and what is unconfirmed.

item.title: GTA 6 Take Care of Jason Walkthrough (Play Nurse)
item.description: GTA 6 Take Care of Jason walkthrough: how the Play Nurse mission works, why it has no map marker, when to check in at the Starlet Motel and when it ends.

item.title: GTA 6 Thrillbillies Walkthrough: Mud Club Dirt Bike Race
item.description: GTA 6 Thrillbillies walkthrough: buy outfits at the Thrillbilly Mud Club, rent a Sanchez at Roostere's Rentals and race Billy's crew for up to $2,500.

item.title: GTA 6 Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab Walkthrough: Armored Truck
item.description: GTA 6 Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab walkthrough: ride with Billy's crew, chase the armored truck until it crashes, blow the rear doors and take the bag for $2,000.
